pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Verse 1]
Into a heart that had endlessly fallen apart,
a small breath softly seeps in.
The fragments that once scattered into the air—
I gather them again with my fingertips.
Even the tears that had long since dried
fall like dew in the early dawn,
and I will gently wrap
the wounds that have grown cold.

[Chorus]
The faintly shimmering light
shines beside my shadow,
stirring deep inside me like a quiet breath,
and I hold on, believing this isn’t the end.

[Verse 2]
Even the loneliness brushed by the wind
remains as a single page of memory.
The sorrow I buried deep within
slowly begins to settle down.

[Chorus]
When even breathing felt too heavy
you called my name once more.
That voice lifts my broken self again,
and I cradle a small courage in my hands.
A new path embraces me into the world,
where a fragile light begins to bloom.
Wrapped in a warm, gentle breath,
I become who I am now.

[Outro]
When the night grows long again,
a tender wave still strikes my chest,
yet even that tide comforts me
and carries me toward a new day.
At the end of crossing the days I once collapsed,
the light finally finds me
and whispers, “You don’t have to cry anymore. It’s alright,”
as it quietly holds me close.
And I am born once again.
pkg.sunoStyle:
Trendy pop with a soft, energetic groove. Modern, fresh and emotional.
Male-female duet vocals throughout. Alternating lines, natural vocal interplay, gentle harmonies, clear and expressive vocals. Keep both voices distinct and balanced.
Light and simple intro with soft harmony. Verses begin gently with light rhythm, subtle percussion and restrained bass. Pre-chorus gradually builds emotional tension through delicate textures and rhythmic movement, without sudden intensity.
Chorus adds warmth and energy with warm bass, gentle harmonies and a smooth rhythmic lift. Emotional and engaging, but controlled and never explosive.
Final section gradually reduces energy, returning to soft duet vocals and minimal accompaniment, ending calm and reflective.
Natural dynamics, warm tone, clean modern production. Avoid loud mastering, heavy bass, excessive drums, dense layers and aggressive instrumentation.
